name: Anhui Guangxin Agrochemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Guangxin Agrochemical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells pesticides technical, preparations, and intermediates in China. It offers fungicides, such as carbendazim, thiophanate-methyl, and oxadiazon; herbicides comprising diuron, glyphosate, and cyclophosphamide; and insecticides, including thiamethoxam, imidacloprid, and chlorpyrifos. The company also provides phosgene intermediates, including o-hydoxybenzonitrile, p-nitrochlorobrnzene, o-nitrochlorobenzene, o-nitroaniline, 2-cyanophenol, phosphorus trichloride, methyl carbamate, o-phenylenediamine, 3,4-dichlorophenyl isocyanate, and ethyl chloroformate; and medicine and new materials consisting of p-nitrophenol sodium…
